messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Albuterol inhalation is used to treat or prevent bronchospasm, or narrowing of the airways in the lungs, in people with asthma or certain types of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). It is also used to prevent exercise-induced bronchospasm.
Albuterol inhalation is for use in adults and children who are at least 2 years old. Always follow your doctor's directions when giving albuterol to a child.

B. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
C. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
